items.title: Coinbase Falls 4%, Robinhood Slides 3% as Hot Inflation Data Drags Bitcoin Lower; Webull Declines 2%

items.title: A Fed Governor Said He'd be Open to a Half-Point Rate Hike if Inflation Came in Hotter. That Just Happened.
items.summary: Waller said in London that he was "leaning toward" a rate hike even if the October reading was softer than expected and would back "more robust action" if it was higher than the forecasts.

items.title: Inflation Came in Hotter Than Expected in October. A Rate Hike is All But Certain Now.
items.summary: U.S. consumer prices rose more than expected in October, sending the implied probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike to 98.8%, according to CME Group data.

items.title: Traders Dial Up Rate-Hike Bets
items.summary: The one-two punch of hot inflation data and hawkish comments from a key Federal Reserve official have traders betting that the Fed could raise rates as much as 0.5 percentage point next month.
